articles.title: Banned at the Chelsea Flower Show, Plastic Grass Is Growing Out of Favour
articles.topic: 人造草坪因破坏环境和生物多样性而备受争议，皇家园艺协会与活动人士反对，政府暂不禁用但要求合规
articles.source: 2023 年考研英语（二）Text 1 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: In the quest for the perfect lawn, homeowners across the country are taking a shortcut—and it is the environment that is paying the price.
sentences.cn: 全国各地的房主都在为追求完美草坪而走捷径——而为之付出代价的却是环境。

sentences.en: About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles.
sentences.cn: 每年大约有 800 万平方米的塑料草坪售出，而反对（塑料草坪）的声音现已蔓延至最高园艺界。

sentences.en: The Chelsea Flower Show has banned fake grass from this year's event, declaring it to be not part of its ethos.
sentences.cn: 切尔西花展已禁止在今年的活动中使用人造草坪，并宣称使用人造草坪不符合其活动理念。

sentences.en: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
sentences.cn: 在伦敦西区举办该年度展会的皇家园艺协会表示，之所以实施这项禁令，是因为塑料草坪会对环境和生物多样性造成破坏。

sentences.en: Ed Horne, of the RHS, said: "We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic.
sentences.cn: 皇家园艺协会的埃德·霍恩表示：“我们去年推出了可持续发展战略，而使用人造草坪与我们的理念以及我们对塑料的看法背道而驰。

sentences.en: We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment."
sentences.cn: 我们建议使用天然草坪，因为它会带来诸多环境效益，包括维持野生动物生存、减轻洪涝灾害以及给环境“降温”。”

sentences.en: The RHS's decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes.
sentences.cn: 皇家园艺协会做出这一决定之际，活动人士正努力提高人们对人造草坪所造成问题的认识。

words.meaning: n. 活动家，运动参加者

sentences.en: A Twitter account, which claims to "cut through the greenwash" of artificial grass, already has more than 20,000 followers.
sentences.cn: 一个推特账户声称要“刺穿人造草坪的‘绿色外衣’”，目前已拥有超过 2 万名关注者。

sentences.en: It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an "ecological damage" tax on such lawns.
sentences.cn: 该账户力劝人们签署两份请愿书，其中一份呼吁禁止销售塑料草坪，另一份则呼吁对此类草坪征收“生态破坏”税。

sentences.en: They have gathered 7,276 and 11,282 signatures.
sentences.cn: 两份请愿书已分别收集到 7276 个和 11282 个签名。

sentences.en: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol.
sentences.cn: 然而，人造草坪的支持者表示，天然草坪需要修剪，因此通常会耗电耗油，也会对环境造成影响。

sentences.en: The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments and that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more.
sentences.cn: 该行业同样指出，天然草坪需要喷洒大量的水和除草剂，还需要其他诸多养护工作，而铺设人造草坪的人往往会更经常使用其花园。

words.meaning: n. 处理（指清理、保护等过程）

sentences.en: The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
sentences.cn: 该行业还声称，铺设人造草坪的人平均会花费 500 英镑在花园的树木或灌木上，而这为昆虫提供了栖息之所。

sentences.en: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has "no plans to ban the use of artificial grass".
sentences.cn: 去年另一份要求禁止人造草坪的请愿书获得了 3 万人签名，对此政府回应道，其“并不打算禁止人造草坪的使用”。

sentences.en: It added: "We prefer to help people and organisations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters.
sentences.cn: 它补充道：“我们更愿帮助公众及相关组织做出正确的选择，而不是就此问题立法。

sentences.en: However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage, while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives."
sentences.cn: 不过，人造草坪的使用必须遵守现有的法律和政策的保障措施，以保护生物多样性，确保排水的可持续性，而诸如加强生物多样性责任的措施，应该有助于鼓励公共当局考虑可持续的替代方案。”

words.meaning: n. 保护措施，保障措施
n. 可供选择的事物，替代物

questions.stem: The RHS thinks that plastic grass ___.
questions.stem_cn: 皇家园艺协会认为塑料草坪___。

options.B: is a hot topic in gardening circles
options.C: is overpraised in the annual show
options.D: is ruining the view of west London

options_cn.A: 对环境有害
options_cn.C: 在年度展会中被过度夸赞
options_cn.D: 正在破坏伦敦西区的景观

questions.explanation: 定位首段末句：皇家园艺协会因塑料草坪破坏生态环境而决定禁用，第二段首句借协会成员之言补充“使用人造草坪与其可持续发展理念不符”。题干+A 是对首段末句 the damage plastic grass does to the environment 的同义改写，A 正确。B 将首段②句客观事实“最高园艺界开始反对塑料草坪”夸大为协会观点“热议话题”；C 将“被禁用”窜改为“被过度夸赞”；D 由碎片信息捏造，文中仅泛指环境危害，未提伦敦西区景观。

questions.stem: The petitions mentioned in Paragraph 3 reveal the campaigners' ___.
questions.stem_cn: 第三段提及的请愿书表明了活动人士的___。

options.B: resistance to fake grass use
options.C: anger over the proposed tax

options_cn.A: 对皇家园艺协会的失望
options_cn.B: 对人造草坪使用的抵制
options_cn.D: 对天然草坪供应的担忧

questions.explanation: 定位第三段：活动人士力劝人们签署两份请愿书，分别呼吁“禁止销售塑料草坪”“对此类草坪征收生态破坏税”。可知请愿书表明活动人士对人造草坪的不满与抵制，B 正确（准确概括 one calling for a ban…another calling for a…tax 所表明的立场）。A 强加因果，误将协会决定视为活动人士行为的原因；C 与请愿内容“支持征税”相悖；D 由碎片信息捏造，文中未提天然草坪供应问题。

questions.stem: In Paragraph 4, supporters of fake grass point out ___.
questions.stem_cn: 在第四段中，人造草坪的支持者指出___。

options.A: the necessity to lower the costs of fake grass
options.B: the disadvantages of growing real grass
options.C: the way to take care of artificial lawns
options.D: the challenges of insect habitat protection

options_cn.A: 降低人造草坪价格的必要性
options_cn.D: 保护昆虫栖息地的挑战

questions.explanation: 定位第四段：支持者指出天然草坪也会对环境造成影响，②③句补充“天然草坪需大量养护，人造草坪更常被使用且不妨碍昆虫栖息”。可知支持者重点强调天然草坪的劣势与人造草坪的优势，B 正确（growing real grass 同义改写 natural lawns，disadvantages 概括 consume electricity or petrol、requires considerable amounts of water 等）。A 断章取义末句，花钱的是树木灌木而非草坪；C 偷换对象；D 无中生有。

questions.stem: What would the government do with regard to artificial grass?
questions.stem_cn: 对于人造草坪，政府将会怎么做？

options.A: Urge legislation to restrict its use.
options.B: Take measures to guarantee its quality.
options.C: Remind its users to obey existing rules.

options_cn.A: 敦促立法以限制其使用。
options_cn.B: 采取措施以保证其质量。
options_cn.C: 提醒其使用者遵守现有规则。
options_cn.D: 用可持续的替代品取代它。

questions.explanation: 定位第五、六段：政府暂无计划禁止人造草坪，但“人造草坪的使用必须遵守现有的法律与政策保障措施”。题干+C 是对政府态度的正确理解，Remind its users to obey existing rules 近义改写 the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place，C 正确。A 与“不愿立法”相悖；B 偷换措施目的（保护生物多样性≠保证质量）；D 将寻找替代品的主体由 public authorities 偷换为 the government。

questions.stem: It can be learned from the text that fake grass ___.
questions.stem_cn: 从本文可以得知人造草坪___。

options.B: has seen a market share decline
options.C: is becoming increasingly affordable

options_cn.A: 正在不断得到改进
options_cn.D: 一直是一个有争议的产品

questions.explanation: 全文围绕人造草坪展开：前三段介绍反对者（皇家园艺协会、活动人士）观点，第四段介绍支持者观点，末两段介绍政府态度。综合可见人造草坪有弊有利、存在诸多争议，D 正确（a controversial product 体现多方不同观点）。A 曲解“房主追求完美草坪”为“不断改进”；B 由“遭反对”过度引申市场份额下降，无依据；C 主观臆断价格问题，文中未提。

articles.title: Our National Parks Are in Crisis. Trump's Solution Is Absurd
articles.topic: 美国国家公园深陷长期资金危机，私有化露营地并非良策，作者呼吁国会增加拨款
articles.source: 2023 年考研英语（二）Text 2 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: It's easy to dismiss as absurd the federal government's ideas for plugging the chronic funding gap of our national parks.
sentences.cn: 联邦政府填补国家公园长期存在的资金缺口的想法很容易被视为荒唐可笑而不予考虑。

words.meaning: adj. 长期存在的，难以根除的

sentences.en: Can anyone really think it's a good idea to allow Amazon deliveries to your tent in Yosemite or food trucks to line up under the redwood trees at Sequoia National Park?
sentences.cn: 难道真的有人会认为，允许亚马逊把货送到约塞米蒂国家公园的帐篷里、或允许食品卡车在（加州）红杉国家公园的红杉树下排队，是个好主意吗？

sentences.en: But the government is right about one thing: U.S. national parks are in crisis.
sentences.cn: 但有一点政府是对的：美国国家公园正处于危机之中。

sentences.en: Collectively, they have a maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion.
sentences.cn: 总的来说，它们所积压的维护费用超过 120 亿美元。

words.meaning: adv. 总体上地，总计达到地

sentences.en: Roads, trails, restrooms, visitor centers and other infrastructure are crumbling.
sentences.cn: 车行道、步行道、卫生间、游客中心和其他基础设施都在日渐破败。

words.meaning: n. （有特定目的的）路线，路径

sentences.en: But privatizing and commercializing the campgrounds would not be a cure-all.
sentences.cn: 然而，将露营地私有化、商业化并非万能之计。

sentences.en: Campgrounds are a tiny portion of the overall infrastructure backlog, and businesses in the parks hand over, on average, only about 5% of their revenues to the National Park Service.
sentences.cn: 露营地只占全部基础设施维护积压工作的极小部分，而且（入驻）公园的商家平均只向国家公园管理局上缴约 5% 的收入。

sentences.en: Moreover, increased privatization would certainly undercut one of the major reasons why 300 million visitors come to the parks each year: to enjoy nature and get a break from the commercial drumbeat that overwhelms daily life.
sentences.cn: 此外，（露营地的）进一步私有化必定会削弱每年 3 亿游客游园的一个主要诱因：享受自然，从淹没日常生活的商业喧嚣中小憩片刻。

words.meaning: n. 击鼓声（此处指商业喧嚣）

sentences.en: The real problem is that the parks have been chronically starved of funding.
sentences.cn: 真正的问题在于国家公园长期缺乏资金。

sentences.en: An economic survey of 700 U.S. taxpayers found that people would be willing to pay a significant amount of money to make sure the parks and their programs are kept intact.
sentences.cn: 一项针对 700 名美国纳税人的经济调查发现，人们愿意支付一大笔钱，以确保国家公园及其项目保持完好无损。

words.meaning: adj. 完好无缺的，完整的

sentences.en: Some 81% of respondents said they would be willing to pay additional taxes for the next 10 years to avoid any cuts to the national parks.
sentences.cn: 约 81% 的受访者表示，他们愿意在未来 10 年内支付额外的税费，以避免对国家公园的任何削减。

sentences.en: The national parks provide great value to U.S. residents both as places to escape and as symbols of nature.
sentences.cn: 国家公园作为隐逸的去处以及自然的象征，为美国居民提供了巨大价值。

sentences.en: On top of this, they produce value from their extensive educational programs, their positive impact on the climate through carbon sequestration, their contribution to our cultural and artistic life, and of course through tourism.
sentences.cn: 除此之外，国家公园也创造价值：它们开展各种各样的教育项目，通过“碳封存”对气候产生积极影响，同时为我们的文化和艺术生活做出贡献，当然还发展旅游业。

words.meaning: adj. 包罗万象的，各种各样的

sentences.en: The parks also help keep America's past alive, working with thousands of local jurisdictions around the country to protect historical sites and to bring the stories of these places to life.
sentences.cn: 国家公园还有助于让美国的历史保持“活力”，它们与全国数千个地方辖区合作，以保护历史遗迹，让这些地方的故事鲜活起来。

words.meaning: n. 管辖区域，管辖范围

words.w: bring the stories of these places to life

sentences.en: The parks do all this on a shoestring.
sentences.cn: 国家公园靠着微薄的资金做着所有这一切。

sentences.en: Congress allocates only $3 billion a year to the national park system—an amount that has been flat since 2001 (in inflation-adjusted dollars) with the exception of a onetime boost in 2009.
sentences.cn: 国会每年仅向国家公园系统拨款 30 亿美元，这一数额自 2001 年以来一直持平（按通货膨胀调整后的美元计算），除 2009 年提振一次以外。

words.meaning: adj. 数量不变的，固定的

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the number of annual visitors has increased by more than 50% since 1980, and now stands at 330 million visitors per year.
sentences.cn: 相比之下，自 1980 年以来，每年的游客人数增长 50% 以上，现如今每年高达 3.3 亿人次。

words.meaning: adv. 相比之下，与此同时

questions.stem: What problem are U.S. national parks faced with?
questions.stem_cn: 美国国家公园面临什么问题？

options.B: Inadequate commercialization.
options.C: Lack of transportation services.

options_cn.A: 营业利润下滑。
options_cn.D: 基础设施维护不善。

questions.explanation: 定位第二段②③句：国家公园积压的维护费用超过 120 亿美元，车行道、步行道、卫生间、游客中心等基础设施都在日渐破败。首句 in crisis 即指“因资金短缺导致基础设施维护不善”，D 正确（概括 Roads, trails…and other infrastructure are crumbling）。A 将 funding gap 曲解为利润亏损；B 源自联邦政府的建议而非题干所问的问题，且与作者质疑立场相悖；C 曲解“配套交通待维护”为“缺乏交通服务”。

questions.stem: Increased privatization of the campgrounds may ___.
questions.stem_cn: 进一步私有化露营地可能会___。

options.B: help preserve nature
options.C: bring operational pressure

options_cn.A: 破坏游客体验
options_cn.D: 增加公园客流

questions.explanation: 定位第四段：进一步私有化必定会削弱游客“享受自然、逃避商业喧嚣”的主要游园动机。A 契合文意（高度概括 undercut…visitors…enjoy nature and get a break from the commercial drumbeat）。B 与“削弱享受自然的动机”的消极色彩相悖；C 与第三段“私有化只能部分缓解压力”不符；D 与“削弱游园动机（降低人数）”相悖。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 5, most respondents in the survey would ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据第五段，接受调查的大多数受访者会___。

options.A: go to the national parks on a regular basis
options.B: advocate a bigger budget for the national parks
options.C: agree to pay extra for the national parks
options.D: support the national parks' recent reforms

options_cn.A: 定期游览国家公园
options_cn.B: 主张增加国家公园的预算
options_cn.C: 同意为国家公园额外付费
options_cn.D: 支持国家公园的近期改革

questions.explanation: 定位第五段末句：约 81% 的受访者愿意在未来 10 年内支付额外的税费，以避免对国家公园的削减。C 正确（同义改写 be willing to pay additional taxes）。A 与调查发现无关；B 将“纳税人额外付税”偷换为“政府增加预算”；D 与第四段“游客会反对而非支持改革”相悖。

questions.stem: The national parks are valuable in that they ___.
questions.stem_cn: 国家公园很有价值，因为它们___。

options.B: have historical significance
options.C: sponsor research on climate
options.D: provide an income for the locals

options_cn.A: 引领旅游业的发展
options_cn.D: 为当地人提供收入

questions.explanation: 定位第六段：公园具游憩、教育、生态、文艺、旅游、历史等多重价值。B 概括了其历史价值（keep America's past alive、protect historical sites、bring the stories…to life）。A 将“发展旅游业创造价值”曲解为“引领旅游业”；C 将“碳封存影响气候”曲解为“资助气候研究”；D 将“与地方辖区合作保护历史”曲解为“为当地人提供收入”。

questions.stem: It can be concluded from the text that the national park system ___.
questions.stem_cn: 从文中可以得知，国家公园系统___。

options.A: is able to cope with staff shortages
options.B: is able to meet visitors' demands
options.C: is in need of a new pricing policy
options.D: is in need of a funding increase

options_cn.A: 能够应付人员短缺
options_cn.D: 需要增加资金拨付

questions.explanation: 全文多次强调国家公园长期资金短缺（the chronic funding gap、a maintenance backlog of more than $12 billion、chronically starved of funding、on a shoestring），言外之意即需要增加资金拨付，D 正确。A 误将 on a shoestring 理解为“人员短缺”，实指资金短缺；B 与“基础设施破败”相悖；C 曲解末段拨款描述对象。

articles.title: The Digital-Era Brain
articles.topic: 互联网时代人脑记忆改变的只是内容而非能力；“认知卸载”减轻记忆负担并改变学习方式，但影响好坏尚无定论
articles.source: 2023 年考研英语（二）Text 3 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: The Internet may be changing merely what we remember, not our capacity to do so, suggests Columbia University psychology professor Betsy Sparrow.
sentences.cn: 哥伦比亚大学心理学教授贝齐·斯帕罗表示，互联网可能只是改变了我们的记忆内容，而并未改变我们的记忆能力。

sentences.en: In 2011, Sparrow led a study in which participants were asked to record 40 factoids in a computer ("an ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain," for example).
sentences.cn: 2011 年，斯帕罗主持了一项研究，参与者被要求在电脑中记录 40 条有趣信息（例如“鸵鸟的眼睛比它的大脑大”）。

sentences.en: Half of the participants were told the information would be erased, while the other half were told it would be saved.
sentences.cn: 一半的参与者被告知这些信息将会被删除，而另一半则被告知信息会被保存。

sentences.en: Guess what? The latter group made no effort to recall the information when quizzed on it later, because they knew they could find it on their computers.
sentences.cn: 你猜怎么着？后一组参与者在随后的测验中丝毫不做努力来回忆这些信息，因为他们知道可以在电脑上找到这些信息。

sentences.en: In the same study, a group was asked to remember both the information and the folders it was stored in.
sentences.cn: 也是在这项研究中，一组参与者被要求同时记住信息和存放信息的文件夹。

sentences.en: They didn't remember the information, but they remembered how to find the folders.
sentences.cn: 他们没有记住信息本身，但记得如何找到文件夹。

sentences.en: In other words, human memory is not deteriorating but "adapting to new communications technology," Sparrow says.
sentences.cn: 换句话说，人类的记忆不是在退化，而是在“适应新的通信技术”，斯帕罗说。

sentences.en: In a very practical way, the Internet is becoming an external hard drive for our memories, a process known as "cognitive offloading."
sentences.cn: 互联网正在以一种非常切实有效的方式成为存储我们记忆的外部硬盘，这个过程被称为“认知卸载”。

sentences.en: Traditionally, this role was fulfilled by data banks, libraries, and other humans.
sentences.cn: 传统上，这个角色是由数据库、图书馆和他人来扮演的。

sentences.en: Your father may never remember birthdays because your mother does, for instance.
sentences.cn: 例如，你的父亲可能从来不记得你们的生日，因为你的母亲记得。

sentences.en: Some worry that this is having a destructive effect on society, but Sparrow sees an upside.
sentences.cn: 有些人担心这一过程正在对社会产生破坏性的影响，但斯帕罗看到了积极的一面。

sentences.en: Perhaps, she suggests, the trend will change our approach to learning from a focus on individual facts and memorization to an emphasis on more conceptual thinking—something that is not available on the Internet.
sentences.cn: 她认为，也许这一趋势将使得我们的学习方式从关注个别事实和死记硬背转变为强调更多的概念性思考——这是互联网所不具备的事物。

sentences.en: "I personally have never seen all that much intellectual value in memorizing things," Sparrow says, adding that we haven't lost our ability to do it.
sentences.cn: “我个人从来不认为死记硬背有那么大的智力价值，”斯帕罗说，并补充指出我们并未失去这样做的能力。

sentences.en: Still other experts say it's too soon to understand how the Internet affects our brains.
sentences.cn: 不过，其他一些专家认为，现在要了解互联网如何影响我们的大脑还为时过早。

sentences.en: There is no experimental evidence showing that it interferes with our ability to focus, for instance, wrote psychologists Christopher Chabris and Daniel J. Simons.
sentences.cn: 比如，心理学家克里斯托弗·查布里斯和丹尼尔·J. 西蒙斯写道，目前没有实验证据表明互联网会干扰我们的专注能力。

sentences.en: And surfing the web exercised the brain more than reading did among computer-savvy older adults in a 2008 study involving 24 participants at the Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior at the University of California, Los Angeles.
sentences.cn: 而且，2008 年加州大学洛杉矶分校塞梅尔神经科学和人类行为研究所开展的一项涉及 24 名参与者的研究显示，在精通电脑的老年人中，浏览网页比阅读更能锻炼大脑。

words.meaning: adj. 有经验的，知识渊博的

sentences.en: "There may be costs associated with our increased reliance on the Internet, but I'd have to imagine that overall the benefits are going to outweigh those costs," observes psychology professor Benjamin Storm.
sentences.cn: “我们对互联网越来越多的依赖可能会带来一些代价，但我不得不说，总体而言，益处将会超过那些代价，”心理学教授本杰明·斯托姆说道。

sentences.en: "It seems pretty clear that memory is changing, but is it changing for the better? At this point, we don't know."
sentences.cn: “很显然，（我们的）记忆正在发生改变，但它是不是在变得更好？目前来说，我们还不知道。”

questions.stem: Sparrow's study shows that with the Internet, the human brain will ___.
questions.stem_cn: 斯帕罗的研究表明，互联网使得人类大脑能够___。

options.B: collect information efficiently
options.C: switch its focus of memory

options_cn.A: 详细分析信息
options_cn.D: 延长记忆时间

questions.explanation: 定位首段（Sparrow led a study…）。①句抛出核心观点“互联网改变的仅是记忆内容，未改变记忆能力”，实验发现（被告知信息不会被删除者不努力记忆、被要求同时记信息与文件夹者只记文件夹路径）及末句“人类记忆不是在退化，而是在适应新的通信技术”共同表明：互联网使大脑转变记忆的关注点，C 正确（switch、focus of memory 对应 changing merely what we remember）。A 由 record 40 factoids 捏造“详细分析”；B 断章取义 made no effort to recall，指“不去记忆”而非“效率变高”；D 曲解 not deteriorating，与记忆时长无关。

questions.stem: The process of "cognitive offloading" ___.
questions.stem_cn: “认知卸载”的过程___。

options.B: keeps our memory from failing
options.C: enables us to classify trivial facts

options_cn.A: 帮助我们识别错误信息
options_cn.C: 让我们能够对琐碎的事实信息进行分类
options_cn.D: 减轻我们的记忆负担

questions.explanation: 定位第二段（cognitive offloading）。①句由“互联网成为记忆的外部硬盘”引出概念，②③句指出该角色曾由数据库、图书馆、他人扮演（爸爸不记生日因妈妈记着）。可见“认知卸载”借工具减轻记忆负担，D 正确（体现 an external hard drive for our memories）。A 由 individual facts 臆断“识别不实信息”；B 随意建立因果，文中未探讨；C 曲解 individual facts 为“分类”。

questions.stem: Which of the following would Sparrow support about the Internet?
questions.stem_cn: 斯帕罗会支持下列哪项关于互联网的说法？

options.A: It may reform our learning approach.
options.B: It may impact our society negatively.
options.C: It may enhance our adaptability to technology.
options.D: It may interfere with our conceptual thinking.

options_cn.A: 它可能会改变我们的学习方式。
options_cn.B: 它可能会对我们的社会造成负面影响。
options_cn.C: 它可能会增强我们对科技的适应能力。
options_cn.D: 它可能会干扰我们的概念性思考。

questions.explanation: 定位第二段④⑤⑥句：斯帕罗认为该趋势“将学习方式从关注个别事实和死记硬背转变为强调概念性思考”，可见她认为互联网可能改变学习方式，A 正确（同义改写 change our approach to learning from…to…）。B 将“有些人的担心”偷换为斯帕罗观点，忽略 but Sparrow sees an upside；C 将“记忆在适应新技术”偷换为“增强对科技的适应力”；D 与“强调概念性思考”相悖。

questions.stem: It is indicated in Paragraph 3 that how the Internet affects our brains ___.
questions.stem_cn: 第三段指出，互联网如何影响我们的大脑___。

options.B: is most studied in older adults
options.C: is reflected in our reading speed

options_cn.A: 有待进一步的学术研究
options_cn.B: 在老年人中研究得最多
options_cn.C: 反映在我们的阅读速度上
options_cn.D: 取决于我们的上网习惯

questions.explanation: 定位第三段。①句“要了解互联网如何影响大脑还为时过早”，②③句引学者之言及研究指出“尚无实验证据表明互联网干扰专注力，反而有证据表明上网比阅读更锻炼大脑”。可见互联网影响尚未可知，仍需进一步学术研究，A 正确（合理解读 too soon to understand）。B 由“涉及老年人的研究”臆断“针对老年人最多”；C、D 曲解③句，该句比较的是“上网 vs 阅读”锻炼大脑的效果，未提阅读速度或上网习惯。

questions.stem: Neither Sparrow nor Storm would agree that ___.
questions.stem_cn: 斯帕罗和斯托姆都不会认同___。

options.A: our reliance on the Internet will be costly
options.B: the Internet is weakening our memory
options.C: memory exercise is a must for our brains
options.D: our ability to focus declines with age

options_cn.A: 依赖互联网会带来损失
options_cn.B: 互联网正在削弱我们的记忆
options_cn.C: 记忆训练是我们大脑的必需品
options_cn.D: 我们的专注能力会随着年龄的增长而衰退

questions.explanation: 由 Storm 及题文同序定位第四段并结合前文斯帕罗观点。斯托姆认为“依赖互联网有代价，但益处大于代价；记忆确在变，但是否变好尚不可知”；斯帕罗认为“互联网只改变记忆内容/学习方式，未使记忆衰退”。二者均不认同“互联网正在削弱我们的记忆”，B 正确。A 是斯托姆认同的观点；C 无中生有，二人均未提“记忆训练”；D 利用第三段碎片信息随意关联，且第三段不涉及二人观点。

articles.title: Teenage Rebels with a Cause
articles.topic: 青春期并非待解决的问题，而是机遇与风险并存的阶段；青少年的亲社会性与叛逆性相伴相生，根源在于对社交奖励的高回报敏感性
articles.source: 2023 年考研英语（二）Text 4 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Teenagers are paradoxical.
sentences.cn: 青少年是自我矛盾的。

sentences.en: That's a mild and detached way of saying something that parents often express with considerably stronger language.
sentences.cn: 这是在以一种温和而客观的方式来表述父母们通常会用强烈得多的言辞所表达的某种现象。

words.meaning: adj. 不动感情的，客观的

sentences.en: But the paradox is scientific as well as personal.
sentences.cn: 但这种矛盾性不仅仅是一种个性特点，也有其科学原因。

sentences.en: In adolescence, helpless and dependent children who have relied on grown-ups for just about everything become independent people who can take care of themselves and help each other.
sentences.cn: 在青春期，曾经几乎事事倚赖大人的、无自理能力的未自立孩童变成了能够料理自己生活并互相帮助的有主见之人。

sentences.en: At the same time, once cheerful and compliant children become rebellious teenage risk-takers.
sentences.cn: 也是在这一时期，曾经欢快听话的孩子变为了叛逆冒险的少年。

words.meaning: adj. 叛逆的，桀骜不驯的

sentences.en: A new study published in the journal Child Development, by Eveline Crone of the University of Leiden and colleagues, suggests that the positive and negative sides of teenagers go hand in hand.
sentences.cn: 发表在期刊《儿童发展》上的一项新研究（研究者为莱顿大学的伊芙琳·克罗恩及其同事）表明，青少年的积极面和消极面相伴随行。

sentences.en: The study is part of a new wave of thinking about adolescence.
sentences.cn: 该项研究属于青春期新思潮（课题研究）的一部分。

sentences.en: For a long time, scientists and policy makers concentrated on the idea that teenagers were a problem that needed to be solved.
sentences.cn: 长久以来，科学家和政策制定者们都专注于这样的理念：青少年（问题）是一项需要解决的棘手问题。

sentences.en: The new work emphasizes that adolescence is a time of opportunity as well as risk.
sentences.cn: 而这项新研究强调青春期是一段机遇与风险并存的时期。

sentences.en: The researchers studied "prosocial" and rebellious traits in more than 200 children and young adults, ranging from 11 to 28 years old.
sentences.cn: 研究人员对 200 多名 11 至 28 岁的儿童及年轻人的“亲社会性”特征和叛逆性特征进行了调查。

sentences.en: The participants filled out questionnaires about how often they did things that were altruistic and positive, like sacrificing their own interests to help a friend, or rebellious and negative, like getting drunk or staying out late.
sentences.cn: 参与者填写了调查问卷，问卷内容为他们做利他的、积极的事情（如舍己为友）的频率，或者做叛逆的、消极的事情（如醉酒或晚归）的频率。

sentences.en: Other studies have shown that rebellious behavior increases as you become a teenager and then fades away as you grow older.
sentences.cn: 其他研究已表明，叛逆行为在进入青少年期后会增加，然后随年纪渐长而逐渐消逝。

sentences.en: But the new study shows that, interestingly, the same pattern holds for prosocial behavior.
sentences.cn: 但有意思的是，这项新研究表明亲社会行为也遵循同样的模式。

sentences.en: Teenagers were more likely than younger children or adults to report that they did things like unselfishly helping a friend.
sentences.cn: 相比更年幼的孩子或者成年人，青少年更有可能报告自己做了诸如无私助友之类的事情。

sentences.en: Most significantly, there was a positive correlation between prosociality and rebelliousness.
sentences.cn: 最重要的是，亲社会性和叛逆性之间存在正相关。

sentences.en: The teenagers who were more rebellious were also more likely to help others.
sentences.cn: 更叛逆的青少年也更可能会帮助他人。

sentences.en: The good and bad sides of adolescence seem to develop together.
sentences.cn: 青春期的好坏两面似乎相伴相生。

sentences.en: Is there some common factor that underlies these apparently contradictory developments?
sentences.cn: 这两种看似矛盾的发展趋势背后是否有着某种共同的影响因素？

words.meaning: n. 发展过程，发展趋势

sentences.en: One idea is that teenage behavior is related to what researchers call "reward sensitivity."
sentences.cn: 一种观点认为青少年的行为与研究人员所称的“回报敏感性”有关。

sentences.en: Decision-making always involves balancing rewards and risks, benefits and costs.
sentences.cn: 决策制定向来需要权衡回报与风险、收益与成本。

sentences.en: "Reward sensitivity" measures how much reward it takes to outweigh risk.
sentences.cn: “回报敏感性”衡量的则是需要多大回报就能覆盖风险。

sentences.en: Teenagers are particularly sensitive to social rewards—winning the game, impressing a new friend, getting that boy to notice you.
sentences.cn: 青少年对社交奖励（如赢得这场比赛、打动某位新朋友、引起那个男孩的注意）格外敏感。

words.meaning: v. 给……留下好印象，打动

sentences.en: Reward sensitivity, like prosocial behavior and risk-taking, seems to go up in adolescence and then down again as we age.
sentences.cn: 像亲社会行为和冒险倾向一样，回报敏感性似乎也是在青春期会不断增强，然后又随年龄渐长而逐渐减弱。

sentences.en: Somehow, when you hit 30, the chance that something exciting and new will happen at that party just doesn't seem to outweigh the effort of getting up off the couch.
sentences.cn: 不知怎地，当你到了 30 岁时，在派对上发生惊喜新鲜之事的机会似乎根本就抵不上你离开沙发站起来所需要花费的气力。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, children growing into adolescence tend to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据第一段，进入青春期的孩子往往会___。

options.B: see the world in an unreasonable way
options.C: have fond memories of their past

options_cn.A: 生成对立的个性特征
options_cn.B: 以非理智的方式看待世界
options_cn.D: 向父母表达自己的爱意

questions.explanation: 定位第一段④⑤句（In adolescence…At the same time…）：青春期既出现积极变化“变成能自理且互助的有主见之人”，又相伴而生消极特点“变为叛逆冒险的少年”，A 正确（opposite personality traits 概括正反两面）。B unreasonable/see the world 文中无据；C 捏造“怀念童年”；D 曲解②句“父母以强烈言辞表达”为“青少年向父母表达爱意”。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 2 that Crone's study ___.
questions.stem_cn: 从第二段可以得知，克罗恩的研究___。

options.B: examines teenagers' emotional problems
options.C: provides a new insight into adolescence

options_cn.A: 探讨了青少年的社会责任
options_cn.B: 调查了青少年的情绪问题
options_cn.C: 提供了对青春期的新见解
options_cn.D: 强调了青少年的消极行为

questions.explanation: 定位第二段：克罗恩研究发现“青少年积极面与消极面并存”，属新思潮的一部分，与传统理念“青少年是需要解决的问题”形成对比，强调“青春期是机遇与风险并存的时期”。可见其提供了对青春期的新见解，C 正确（provides a new insight 同义改写 a new wave of thinking）。A 由 prosocial 捏造“社会责任”，曲解研究课题；B 张冠李戴，强调消极面的是“传统观点”，且并非情绪问题；D 对④句断章取义。

questions.stem: What does Crone's study find about prosocial behavior?
questions.stem_cn: 克罗恩的研究就“亲社会行为”有何发现？

options.A: It results from the wish to cooperate.
options.B: It is cultivated through education.
options.C: It is subject to family influence.
options.D: It tends to peak in adolescence.

options_cn.A: 它源自于合作的意愿。
options_cn.D: 它在青春期趋于巅峰。

questions.explanation: 定位第四段②句至第五段（the same pattern holds for prosocial behavior）：亲社会行为遵循与叛逆行为“同样的模式”——在青春期增加、此后消逝，即在青春期达到顶峰，D 正确（peak in adolescence 推断自 increases as you become a teenager and then fades away）。A 主观得出“源自合作意愿”，研究未探究成因；B、C 受常识影响主观臆断“教育/家庭影响”，原文未提。

questions.stem: It can be learned from the last two paragraphs that teenagers ___.
questions.stem_cn: 从最后两段可推知，青少年___。

options.B: care a lot about social recognition
options.C: become anxious about their future
options.D: endeavor to live a joyful life

options_cn.A: 过分强调自己对他人的影响
options_cn.D: 努力追求愉快的生活

questions.explanation: 定位第六、七段。第七段①句指出青少年对社交奖励（赢得比赛、打动新朋友、引起注意）格外敏感，即格外看重社会认可，B 正确（care a lot about social recognition 同义改写 particularly sensitive to social rewards）。A 对 impressing…getting…to notice you 断章取义；C 将“回报随年龄减少”曲解为“担心未来”；D 拔高至“生活目的”层面。

questions.stem: What is the text mainly about?
questions.stem_cn: 本文主要讲述的是什么？

options.B: Why teenagers are risk-sensitive.
options.C: How teenagers develop prosociality.

options_cn.A: 为何青少年是自我矛盾的。
options_cn.B: 为何青少年对风险敏感。
options_cn.C: 青少年如何增强亲社会性。
options_cn.D: 青少年如何实现自我独立。

questions.explanation: 全文首段提出“青少年是自我矛盾的：既独立互助，又叛逆冒险”，第二至五段详述研究发现，第六、七段分析原因“青少年格外在意社交奖励”。整体为“阐释现象—分析原因”结构，A 正确（Why teenagers are self-contradictory 体现核心话题与论证结构）。B 将 reward sensitivity 与 risk-taking 杂糅捏造出“对风险敏感”；C、D 以偏概全，只涉及两面性之一，且文章未论述增强亲社会性/实现独立的方法。
